definitions: The state of animal dormancy, similar to hibernation, characterized by inactivity and a lowered metabolic rate, that occurs in response to high temperatures and arid conditions.
The arrangement of the parts of a flower in a bud.
examples: Many desert animals enter estivation during the hottest months.
The estivation of the petals protects the developing flower.
Snails often undergo estivation to survive dry periods.
